verdict.rationale: Clerky documents an official remote MCP server at https://mcp.clerky.com/mcp, with setup instructions for Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants, scoped to the team access the user authorizes. A live probe confirms the endpoint exists and is OAuth-gated, returning HTTP 401 without a token. Missing for 10: the server appears to expose read-only tools only, the evidence lists no specific tools, and there is no independent or community hands-on report of using it.
